title: Bowing, playing cello parts and closing
summary: Garland likes bowing under a clarinet like a cello, always creative rather than routine, and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

I take cello, I take your part. I play cello.
Oh, honey, I played me some pretty good cello parts in it.
